content.title: How to Watch: USMNT vs. Belgium on Saturday, March 28 in Atlanta, Georgia
content.text: Find out where to watch, stream and listen to all the action from Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, GeorgiaMarch 27, 2026The U.S. Men's National Team opens its 2026 campaign at Mercedes-Benz Stadium in Atlanta, Georgia, against ninth-ranked Belgium in the USA’s first of four matches ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Fans can watch the game on TNT and HBO Max in English and Telemundo, Universo and Peacock in Spanish on Saturday, March 28 at 3:30 p.m. ET.Here's how to catch all the live action:HOW TO WATCH USMNT vs. BELGIUM ON TVThe match will be broadcast live on TNT with English commentary. Spanish commentary can be found on Telemundo starting at 3:30 p.m. ET. Pregame coverage begins at 3 p.m. ET. HOW TO STREAM USMNT vs. BELGIUMFans can stream USMNT vs. Belgium on HBO MAX with English commentary and Universo and Peacock with Spanish commentary starting at 3:30 p.m. ET. Pregame coverage begins at 3 p.m. ET.HOW TO LISTEN TO USMNT vs. BELGIUM ON RADIOFans can listen to the action live on Westwood One Sports platforms, the English-language audio partner of U.S. Soccer. Spanish-language commentary can be found on Fútbol de Primera. Coverage of USA vs. Belgium will begin at 3 p.m. ET. FOLLOW USMNT ON SOCIAL MEDIAIn addition to broadcast information, fans are encouraged to follow the action during the match on social media. You can stay up-to-date by following @USMNT on X and Instagram and U.S. Soccer on Facebook and @usmnt.ussoccer.com on Bluesky.FOLLOW ALONG ON WEB AND APPLive score updates and lineup information will be available at the official Match Hub here. Fans can also download the U.S. Soccer App to track match insights, choose your own Starting XI, see match highlights, vote for the Insiders’ Man of the Match & more!
